public_rationale: Anthropic's announcement corroborates the $30 billion round and February 12 date. Neither that announcement nor the lead investor's account establishes that the described media campaign helped secure it. Publicity followed by financing is insufficient to establish causation. The investor's emphasis on other considerations also does not prove the campaign had no effect.
limitations: Public funding announcements may omit influences discussed privately.
The funding fact is corroborated; the overall causal proposition remains unresolved.
